entities.summary: The Széchenyi István University (SZE), also known as the University of Győr, is a residential university established in 1968, and is described as a private institution having as its main campus a location on the Danube River, a short walk from the Győr, Hungary city centre. As of 2026, SZE had nine faculties serving in Győr, and at a second campus in Mosonmagyaróvár, Hungary. The university offers a variety of degrees through to the doctoral, with an emphasis on science, technology, and engineering, and it has a "strong commitment to internationali[s]ation" in its offering a large variety of English-taught programmes at all levels.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a leading institution in science, technology, and engineering education in Hungary, Széchenyi István University has contributed to the country's economic growth through its large variety of English-taught programmes, with over 90% of its graduates finding employment within six months of graduation. Its strong commitment to internationalization has also fostered partnerships with top universities worldwide.
